content.short: Waffle Capital is an incubator fund investing in promising native Cardano assets and early protocols.
content.description: Waffle Capital Ltd. is an approved fund that is strategically investing in the most promising native assets and protocols within the Cardano ecosystem. At Waffle Capital, we see Cardano's blockchain ecosystem as a prime opportunity for discerning investors. Stemming from rigorous academic research and evidence-driven methods, Cardano offers superior open-source blockchain capabilities. Its efficient Proof-of-Stake protocol, Ouroboros, ensures robust system resilience and reduces energy consumption, standing out from rivals like Bitcoin.
